about_the_game:
Welcome to the Dungeon Legend Party!

Dance in the whirlpool of death, and write your survival epic with blood!
“When the ancient dungeon opens thousands of crimson eyes, only the most cunning survivors will witness the next dawn…”

【Core Gameplay】

This is a dungeon style roguelike adventure game.
🔥 Weave a web of survival with evasive maneuvers and ignite counter-storms with skills amidst 360-degree demonic onslaughts! Each 15-30-minute life-or-death roulette challenges your real-time decision-making and Operation wow.

(Star Burst Stream!)

【Shop System】

  • Use currency to purchase skill tomes and learn otherworldly abilities

  • Buy healing items to save yourself from the brink of death

  • Spend hellish skeleton coins to challenge infernal bosses and claim epic gear

【Legendary Characters】
🎭 Choose your survival avatar:

  • Cyber Swordsman “Blade Draw” – Unleash wide-range sword slashes

  • Primordial Man “Awakening” – Grow stronger in three attributes with each activation

  • AK47 Chicken “Cluckfire” – Rain down rapid-fire bullet barrages
    Each character boasts unique ultimate skills. Mix and match skills from shop tomes to craft your ultimate build!

(Breath of Blood!)

【Game Art】
Where flesh and machinery merge into cosmic horror!
Carve lethal geometries in space with bullet-hell patterns.
Every boss battle is a dynamic art exhibition – when the screen trembles under millions of damage numbers, you’ll grasp the true meaning of violent aesthetics!

“Remember: In this subterranean labyrinth, survival isn’t the goal—conquering death in the most spectacular fashion is the only true legend!”

(guitar hero!)
